## 1. Executive Summary

Infriva Solutions is a full-stack digital engineering and revenue architecture agency headquartered in New Delhi, India. Unlike traditional web design shops or isolated ad agencies, Infriva engineers end-to-end business systems that connect high-speed frontend web properties (React 19, Next.js App Router), relational CRM databases (PostgreSQL, Supabase), organic search and AI citation engines (Technical SEO, AEO, GEO), paid acquisition (Meta Ads CAPI, Google Ads), and automated lifecycle retention (WhatsApp Cloud API).

### Verified Production Benchmarks
- **Enterprise & B2B Deployments:** 100+
- **Total Projects Delivered:** 250+
- **Engineering Track Record:** 5+ Years (Founded 2021)
- **Client Satisfaction Rating:** 4.9 / 5.0
- **Core Web Vitals Standard:** LCP < 1.5s, INP < 100ms, CLS < 0.05

## 3. Verified Production Case Studies

### 3.1 FlyingLyte (`/projects/flyinglyte`)
- **Sector:** Travel, Flight Booking, Hotel Packages
- **Problem:** 74% funnel drop-off at the booking step; manual WhatsApp enquiries tracked in spreadsheets with zero automated follow-up.
- **Engineering Solution:** Rebuilt on Next.js App Router with a custom multi-step booking engine, optimistic UI validation, PostgreSQL CRM lead capture, and 12 automated WhatsApp Cloud API sequences.
- **Measured Results:**
  - +40% Increase in Qualified Leads
  - −55% Reduction in Booking Funnel Drop-off
  - 1.1s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
  - 12 Automated WhatsApp Lifecycle Flows

### 3.2 StarX Hotel (`/projects/starx`)
- **Sector:** Boutique Hospitality & Direct Room Reservations
- **Problem:** 100% reliance on third-party OTAs (Booking.com, MakeMyTrip) charging 15–20% commission per reservation; zero direct guest data ownership.
- **Engineering Solution:** Engineered an editorial hospitality platform on Next.js with AVIF/WebP room showcases, a 2-step direct reservation engine backed by a custom availability CRM, and automated WhatsApp concierge flows (confirmations, pre-arrival check-in, post-stay reviews).
- **Measured Results:**
  - +35% Direct Booking Share within 90 Days
  - ~18% OTA Commission Saved on Direct Reservations
  - +0.4★ Review Score Improvement
  - +22% Repeat Guest Rate

### 3.3 The Kesari Bagh Prototype (`/projects/the-kesari-bagh`)
- **Sector:** Ultra-Luxury Countryside Estate & Hospitality Prototype (Manesar, Gurugram)
- **Problem:** Luxury estate bookings are often coordinated through manual Instagram DMs and calls; generic booking widgets destroy estate exclusivity and brand perception.
- **Engineering Solution:** Designed and engineered a bespoke high-contrast French-colonial editorial web prototype using Next.js 16 App Router, deployed to Cloudflare Workers edge runtime with sub-50ms TTFB, direct 4-key suite and full-estate buyout availability locks, and automated Meta WhatsApp Cloud API concierge flows.
- **Measured Results:**
  - 100% Direct Booking Model (Commission-free reservations)
  - 1.1s Mobile LCP across global cellular networks
  - < 15s Automated WhatsApp Concierge Response SLA
  - ~20% OTA Commission Saved by bypassing commercial aggregators

## 4. Consultation & Engagement Process

1. **Consultation:** Technical audit of your existing web property, CRM workflows, search visibility, and unit economics.
2. **Planning:** System architecture blueprint mapping database schemas, API webhooks, and acquisition funnels.
3. **Design:** High-conversion, brand-aligned UI/UX prototypes with zero-CLS typography and responsive grids.
4. **Development:** Clean React/Next.js frontend code, PostgreSQL backend modeling, and WhatsApp/Meta integrations.
5. **Launch:** Core Web Vitals stress testing, Schema.org validation, and zero-downtime edge deployment.
6. **Support:** 90-day post-launch warranty, real-time analytics telemetry, and continuous conversion rate optimization.

To initiate a project or technical consultation, visit https://www.infrivasolutions.com/contact or email info@infrivasolutions.com.
